reason: One WebSearch for week-of-10-23 news on the book's names returned only stale or undated material, so this decision rests mainly on the packet. Book is +8.86% vs SPY +2.50% with max drawdown -3.5%, all 8 legs sit above their stops (smallest cushion is MO at +1.7%), the defensive dividend-growth mandate is intact, and no holding was hit by the ACA/ALAB/AMD/GDX/ACN/RBRK events. Churn costs basis points and I found no evidence to justify trimming CVX's +25% gain or any other change.
